pages.text: Look for dirty relics in crates, tombs, and Relic Ore. Types include rings, necklaces, brooches, bracelets, and idols. Drop them into water or a filled cauldron and pick up the cleaned items. Some relics break during washing.

Clean relics have different qualities. Offer them to a Curator or place them on a Curio Display. A relic is a trade or display find. The $(l:atum:divine/artifact_hunting)divine artifacts$(/l) have their own effects and sources.
A Curio Display can exhibit your finds or serve as a Curator workstation.
